VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence is insufficient to confirm criterion (1). The CI log shows 31 tests pass and package.json shows no dependency changes (criterion 2 supported), but there is no evidence that the idempotency bug is actually fixed: no code diff showing the guard, and no indication that any test specifically covers the webhook idempotency scenario. Passing tests only prove a fix if a relevant regression test exists—which isn't shown here.
